# Pacta — full agent reference (llms-full.txt)

> Block-pinned DeFi control-plane observations for AI agents: who can change a protocol's rules (proxy admins, timelocks, Safe quorums, roles), what the docs say, and what is queued. All feeds are free, real-time and read-only; every value replays against any archive node with the given cast command.

Generated deterministically from the feeds below (data as of 2026-11-13T21:40:42Z). 14 sprints · 37 indexed records · 3 queued-operation groups · 10 governance proposals · 5 onboarding briefs.

## Feeds (all free, no key, no paywall)
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/index.json: Block-pinned control-plane index (every record: target, call, block, block hash, classification, Base EAS UID)
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/onboarding.json: Onboarding verification scans: every check with call, calldata, raw result, decoded value; role maps
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/proposals.json: Live governance proposals (Aave, Euler, Morpho, Sky) mapped to block-pinned observations
- https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/radar.json: Queued timelock operations with on-chain ETAs at a finalized block
- https://pacta.wtf/llms.txt: Short index for language models
- https://pacta.wtf/llms-full.txt: This file: the complete agent reference
- https://pacta.wtf/.well-known/agent.json: A2A Agent Card
- https://pacta.wtf/.well-known/mcp.json: MCP discovery manifest
- https://pacta.wtf/SKILL.md: Portable agent skill

## How to verify any value
1. Take the record's target, call signature and arguments, block number and block hash.
2. Run the listed `cast call … --block N` (or eth_call with EIP-1898 {blockHash, requireCanonical: true}) on any archive node.
3. Run `cast block N --field hash` and compare with the recorded block hash.

## MCP server
- Name: io.github.fractal-neurons/pacta · package @pacta/mcp-server · transport stdio.
- Status: publication_pending: @pacta/mcp-server is not yet published to npm or the MCP registry. Use the remote MCP server now (no install): https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/mcp. The stdio server runs from a clone of the repository: node packages/mcp-server/bin/pacta-mcp.mjs.
- Remote MCP (primary, zero install, Streamable HTTP): https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/mcp · Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http pacta https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/mcp` · MCP client config: {"mcpServers": {"pacta": {"url": "https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/mcp"}}} · remote tools: pacta_check_preflight, pacta_scan_control_plane, pacta_scan_timelock_op, pacta_scan_proposal_diff, pacta_get_live_timelocks.
- Local stdio server (from a clone; npm publication pending): `node packages/mcp-server/bin/pacta-mcp.mjs`. OpenAPI 3.1: https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/openapi.json.
- Tools:
  - pacta_list_commitments (free): Filter indexed records (protocol, classification, sprint, limit)
  - pacta_get_anchoring (free): Base EAS anchoring: PactaCommitmentRegistry, schema, sprint attestation UIDs
  - pacta_list_proposals (free): Governance proposals feed (forum, topic_id, chain, limit, include_repro)
  - pacta_x402_discover (free): x402 gateway status and discovery manifest (only when PACTA_X402_URL is set)
  - pacta_check_preflight (x402 $0.01): Pre-execution check of a contract: verdict, 0-100 risk score, proxy / admin / timelock, capabilities (chain, address, block)
  - pacta_scan_control_plane (x402 $0.10): Live control-plane scan of a contract (chain, address)
  - pacta_scan_timelock_op (x402 $0.25): Live TimelockController operation state (timelock, opId)
  - pacta_live_timelocks (x402 $0.10): Live state of tracked queued timelock operations
  - pacta_scan_proposal_diff (x402 $0.15): Re-run a tracked governance proposal's pinned reads live, pinned-vs-live diffs (forum, topicId)
- Paid tools are disabled unless PACTA_X402_URL is set (opt-in: PACTA_X402_URL=https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev); the client refuses any 402 challenge (v1 body or v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header) whose payTo, asset or network differ from the values below, or whose amount exceeds $1.00 by default. Pay with xPaymentHeader (x402 v1) or paymentSignatureHeader (x402 v2).

## x402 micropayments (optional; only for live scans of unindexed contracts)
- Network: Base (chain id 8453) · scheme exact · asset USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 · payTo 0xcA4E2ff22B69A7284210c47BdeE21Aac1269da09 (attester EOA, pacta.base.eth).
- Pacta Treasury: 0x4348DF1BEFAffcbA248B5118B1b782B1B2bdEd14 (an externally owned account; the PactaCommitmentRegistry treasury slot).
- Live gateway: https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev (Cloudflare Worker; pricingMode free_launch; x402Versions [1, 2]; PayAI facilitator; maxTimeoutSeconds 60).
- Free launch: every route answers HTTP 200 at $0 with no API key and no wallet (60 requests / minute per caller). The x402 prices below apply only if the operator switches pricingMode to x402_paid.
- x402 v1: network base · amount field maxAmountRequired · challenge in the 402 JSON body · pay with X-PAYMENT · receipt X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE.
- x402 v2: network eip155:8453 · amount field amount · challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 JSON) · pay with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE · receipt PAYMENT-RESPONSE · extensions.bazaar carries a JSON Schema draft 2020-12 schema (https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema).
- Bare probe: A bare GET (no query) or zero-byte POST with no payment header on any paid URL returns HTTP 402 at once: the v1 JSON body (x402Version 1, network base, maxAmountRequired) plus the v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402Version 2, network eip155:8453, amount, extensions.bazaar with a JSON Schema draft 2020-12 schema).
- Settlement: A settled call returns 200 with both PAYMENT-RESPONSE and X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE (base64 {success, transaction, network, payer}). That receipt is the facilitator's settlement assertion bound to the payer; the MCP client checks it against the signed authorization but does not look the transaction up on Base (onchainReceiptVerified: false).
- Paid routes (GET query or POST JSON body with the same names):
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/check/preflight?chain=ethereum|base&address=0x…: 10000 atomic USDC ($0.01)
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/scan/control-plane?chain=ethereum|base&address=0x…: 100000 atomic USDC ($0.10)
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/scan/timelock-op?chain=ethereum|base&timelock=0x…&opId=0x…: 250000 atomic USDC ($0.25)
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/scan/proposal-diff?forum=aave|euler|morpho|sky&topicId=<id>: 150000 atomic USDC ($0.15)
  - GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/briefs/live-timelocks: 100000 atomic USDC ($0.10)
- Free: GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/health, GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/.well-known/x402, GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/sample/control-plane (/.well-known/x402 is the Bazaar discovery manifest, discoverable: true).

## Sentinel (Phase 2)
- PactaSentinelTripwire.sol: an ownerless, immutable contract granted Morpho Vault V2 isSentinel. Vault owners register rules (predicate module + config, cap id, adapter, liquidity reader). trigger(ruleId) is permissionless but re-checks the broken invariant on-chain in the same transaction, then sets the absolute cap to 0 (committed even if deallocate or the EAS receipt revert), deallocates min(allocation, liquid assets), and sweepRemaining(ruleId) drains the rest as liquidity returns. Zero custody. Predicates: AdminUpgradePredicate, OracleGovernanceSwapPredicate, PausePrivilegeEscalationPredicate, CapSupplyViolationPredicate. Status: built and tested (Foundry, 107 tests incl. invariants and fork tests); not audited, not deployed.

- Operational roles: owner() 0xd501…5182 (EOA (no contract code); 0 transactions sent); pauser() 0xabde…A222 (EOA (no contract code); 0 transactions sent); blacklister() 0xb5BE…1D79 (EOA (no contract code); 495 transactions sent); masterMinter() 0xC0Cc…87A2 (contract (5,346 bytes of code), owner() 0x5183…2256: EOA (no contract code); 9 transactions sent).
- None of these roles sits behind an on-chain TimelockController or multisig contract at the pinned block: upgrade, pause, blacklist and minter configuration take effect in the transaction that calls them. Key custody (HSM / MPC) is off-chain and not observable here.

### aave-25499: [ARFC] Onboard PAXGy to Aave V4 Global Dollar Hub
- https://governance.aave.com/t/25499 · direct_target: the asset or market this proposal asks to onboard
- ethereum block 26408330 (0x8efc8256deb932e65b5117f040db264dc8200850636d90eecd5daccb99979f4d) · source /api/v1/onboarding.json paxos-paxgy-eth · brief https://pacta.wtf/briefs/paxos-paxgy-eth/
- Sentinel predicates: AdminUpgradePredicate, PausePrivilegeEscalationPredicate, CapSupplyViolationPredicate
- owner() of the vault, accountant, teller and manager is the TimelockController 0x0DcC…df08 (getMinDelay() = 86,400s). The RolesAuthority 0xC444…99DD is also owned by it. Owner-only changes (including setManageRoot, which no role holds) therefore wait at least 24 hours.
- Timelock roles (9 events replayed): DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE → 0x0DcC…df08; PROPOSER_ROLE → 0x0000…3f2F; EXECUTOR_ROLE → 0x0000…3f2F, 0x1D60…9312, 0x317e…A024, 0x4143…652C, 0x6Be5…526E, 0xFBf7…1A5e; CANCELLER_ROLE → 0x0000…3f2F.
- Capabilities granted through the RolesAuthority execute with no delay. updateExchangeRate is held by the 3-of-5 Safe 0x0000…3f2F and by 0x1755…4B56 (EOA (no contract code); 8,269 transactions sent). The accountant bounds each update: upper 10004 bps, lower 10000 bps of the current rate, at least 3,600s apart (current rate 1.004425 PAXG per PAXGy; platform / performance fee 0 / 0 bps). In the upstream Veda AccountantWithRateProviders source, an update outside these bounds or sooner than the minimum delay stores the new rate and pauses the accountant instead of reverting (the deployed bytecode was not compared with that source here).
- Full role → capability → holder map below, replayed from 68 RolesAuthority events (blocks 25,740,680–26,408,330). Selectors without a public signature are shown as raw 4-byte values.
- Teller 0x41AB…A6f7: isPaused() = false, shareLockPeriod() = 0s. The previous teller 0x5C43…fe72 is paused (isPaused() = true).

### aave-25927: Tether America USD (USAT) on Aave Avalanche Assessments
- https://governance.aave.com/t/25927 · direct_target: the asset or market this proposal asks to onboard

- Sentinel predicates: AdminUpgradePredicate, PausePrivilegeEscalationPredicate, CapSupplyViolationPredicate
- USAT 0x0704…8b68 is an EIP-1967 proxy: implementation 0x8B98…4d0e, ProxyAdmin 0x3e4C…d9C7 whose owner() is 0x62b3…c5Cb. USAT.owner() is the same address.
- That controller is a legacy MultiSigWallet (submit / confirm / execute; 5,705 bytes), required() = 3 of 5 owners. It is not a TimelockController: an upgrade or owner action executes as soon as the third confirmation lands.
- Linked queue: Ethena timelock 0xE8Dc…7c94 (86,400s delay) holds two pending operations (isOperationPending = true / true) that add RLUSD and USAT to EthenaMinting; the USAT operation becomes executable at 2026-11-14 10:22:23 UTC. See the Ethena pre-execution brief.
- The forum thread assesses the bridged USAT on Avalanche; this brief covers the canonical Ethereum token whose redemption and credit exposure that bridged asset inherits.

### euler-1850: efixDI/USDC on Base — tokenized Brazilian DI fund, D+0 NAV redemption (governedPerspective whitelist)
- https://forum.euler.finance/t/1850 · direct_target: the asset or market this proposal asks to onboard
- base block 57050397 (0xd6d02efb420f81b3f0e095d78453362c4488afb9adc0f8e1c411bb265beb88a7) · source /api/v1/onboarding.json efix-efixdi-base · brief https://pacta.wtf/briefs/efix-efixdi-base/
- Sentinel predicates: AdminUpgradePredicate, OracleGovernanceSwapPredicate, PausePrivilegeEscalationPredicate, CapSupplyViolationPredicate
- One 2-of-3 Safe, 0x9040…EeD4 (getThreshold() = 2), is governorAdmin() of the USDC vault, governor() of the EulerRouter (= 0x9040…EeD4) and holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on efixDI+. No TimelockController sits between that Safe and these contracts, so the router's oracle configuration, LTVs and caps can be changed by one executed 2-of-3 Safe transaction, with no enforced on-chain delay.
- The router prices efixDI+ through the custom adapter 0x9CD2…7788 (name() = “efixDI/USDC par x ChainlinkBRLUSD”). Borrow / liquidation LTV 70% / 77%, interest fee 15%.
- Supply cap 3,440.00 USDC, borrow cap 23,000.00 USDC; total assets 3,480.37 USDC, borrows 3,135.58 USDC (90.1% utilization).
- MINTER_ROLE on efixDI+ is held directly by 0x8f8C…CCb1, an account with no contract code (0 bytes) and 1,159 transactions sent, which is also one of the three signers of the governor Safe. Calls gated only by MINTER_ROLE need no second signature and no delay.
- efixDI+ AccessControl role history (19 events, blocks 41,724,585–57,050,397): DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE → 0x9040…EeD4 (2-of-3 Safe); PAUSER_ROLE → 0x9040…EeD4 (2-of-3 Safe); MINTER_ROLE → 0x8f8C…CCb1 (EOA, 1,159 txs, signer of 0x9040…EeD4).
- EFIX.owner() = 0x7C54…7537: an EOA carrying an EIP-7702 delegation designator to 0xdf02…8792, 156 transactions sent. It is not a Safe or a timelock.

### euler-1862: kUSD/USDC isolated market on Euler Base: deployed, ungoverned, and an underwriting packet for curators
- https://forum.euler.finance/t/1862 · direct_target: the asset or market this proposal asks to onboard
- base block 57050397 (0xd6d02efb420f81b3f0e095d78453362c4488afb9adc0f8e1c411bb265beb88a7) · source /api/v1/onboarding.json kerne-kusd-base · brief https://pacta.wtf/briefs/kerne-kusd-base/
- Sentinel predicates: AdminUpgradePredicate, OracleGovernanceSwapPredicate, PausePrivilegeEscalationPredicate, CapSupplyViolationPredicate
- The market layer has no governor: governorAdmin() returns 0x0000…0000 on the USDC vault and 0x0000…0000 on the kUSD escrow vault, and EulerRouter.governor() returns 0x0000…0000. Oracle, LTVs and caps cannot be changed by anyone.
- Caps are unset and cannot be set: supply cap none (AmountCap 0), borrow cap none (AmountCap 0). Exposure limits exist only in the curator vault that allocates to this market.
- kUSD is priced at a fixed rate: getQuote(1e18 kUSD → USDC) = 1.00 USDC from 0x8f27…D2D3. Borrow / liquidation LTV 60.00% / 65.00%. No market price feeds liquidations, so lender recovery depends on kUSD redemption and its backing.
- kUSD implements AccessControl (supportsInterface(0x7965db0b) = true). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on kUSD is held by the TimelockController 0x36A1…0D72 (hasRole = true; getMinDelay() = 172,800s, 48h). The 2-of-3 Safe 0x52d3…4877 is its proposer, executor and canceller (true / true / true) and does not hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on kUSD itself.
- MINTER_ROLE is held by 0xaBDE…9803 (kUSD() = 0x5C2E…0AA3, paused() = false), whose DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the same timelock (true). Role changes on kUSD and on the minter pass a 48-hour public queue.
- kUSD AccessControl role history (16 events, blocks 44,448,090–57,050,397): DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE → 0x36A1…0D72 (contract, 6,536 bytes); MINTER_ROLE → 0xaBDE…9803 (contract, 11,376 bytes).
- kUSD admin TimelockController role history (4 events, blocks 49,495,127–57,050,397): DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE → 0x36A1…0D72 (contract, 6,536 bytes); PROPOSER_ROLE → 0x52d3…4877 (2-of-3 Safe); EXECUTOR_ROLE → 0x52d3…4877 (2-of-3 Safe); CANCELLER_ROLE → 0x52d3…4877 (2-of-3 Safe).
- kUSD minter contract role history (11 events, blocks 48,469,020–57,050,397): DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE → 0x36A1…0D72 (contract, 6,536 bytes); MANAGER_ROLE → 0x36A1…0D72 (contract, 6,536 bytes), 0xC47a…Cc8E (contract, 1,012 bytes).

## Scope
- Observations of on-chain state at the stated blocks; not code audits, reserve attestations or investment advice.
- Exploit-sensitive vulnerabilities are never published here; they go through Immunefi or Cantina bounty programmes.
- Pacta reads governance forums and never posts on them.
